task.title: Implement W&B offline and gated sync adapter
task.summary_zh: 新增真正 W&B adapter：預設 offline/local run store，不匯入 SDK 或連線；online sync 必須明確 gate，run/artifact ref 能被 registry/evaluator 查到。
acceptance: default backend remains non-networked and fail-closed
WandB SDK import happens only in explicit gated adapter path
offline local run store records metrics params artifact refs and checksums
online sync requires separate WANDB online gate and safe error policy
BFF and registry can read run refs without activating online sync
